nom: Peach Slices Snail Rescue Ultimate Eye Gel

avis.texte: I was pretty skeptical of snail slime for my skin, but I had heard it does great things, so decided to try a small tube. I am absolutely amazed at the difference in my under eye area. The mucin has smoothed the lines, and made my eyes look brighter. Who knew snails could produce such wonderful, sustainable miracles?

avis.titre: This product gave me an allergic reaction
avis.texte: I tried this product as soon as I got home and when I went to go wash my face I noticed a rash on the eye I put it on. it also made my eye very dark!
I'm loving this product! After one use, I could see a HUGE difference.

I have very sensitive skin around my eyes, they get irritated very easily but honestly! This didn't irritate me at all. It is very thick, I do think most snail related products are thick. But I really like it! I haven't used it long enough to see if it will help with my fine lines but I'm gonna try and start using it more regularly because I don't want my fine lines to get worse

I do not write reviews, I'm 27yrs old, and I've never worn sunscreen or taken care of my skin until now. But let me tell you, this eye cream has been working absolute numbers. My undereye is brighter and it's only been 8 days! Can't recommend enough!

I struggle with millia and typical eye creams make it worse. But i also have dry skin so my undereyes have been needing a treatment. This one is incredible because it absorbs well into the skin and I've definitely noticed the brightening effects. 10/10

I'm prone to dark, puffy circles under my eyes, and I've been very pleasantly surprised by how much this serum is able to help. Not only is the skin actually moisturized for once in my life, but I don't look like I'm not sleeping anymore.
I love snail mucin and this eye gel was so nice! It's not greasy, absorbs quickly and sits well under makeup. I have combo skin and my under eyes get a little dry, but this seems to help

I'm nearly 40 and have had very dark circles under my eyes for as long as I can remember. This product has drastically improved how dark they are and the product is incredibly hydrating. I will continue to repurchase after seeing such great results.

I love this line and have a few of the Snail Rescue products I use regularly as well as my son. I saw this and wanted to try it. The few times I've used it, I have noticed it does as expected thus far. I also purchased the other eye cream (peach&lily eye brightener) and have been alternating usage and cannot decide which is my favorite yet! Good position to be in!

I'm in cold, dry New England and active ingredients are irritating my skin right now, in particular my sensitive undereye skin. This doesnt do that, applies easily, and leaves me feeling hydrated. Will definitely repurchase!

I love the ingredients, I haven't had any milia formation, and I'm happy to have this in my rotation. Do I think it's helping with dark circles to the degree that I need my eye creams to be helping me right now (37 weeks pregnant)? No. Do I like it anyway? Yes. It is a little sticky before fully absorbing so I can't immediately apply eye makeup but that's okay because I rarely do. For the full dark-circle-helping effect, I like Peach and Lily's eye balm (the one in the jar). This gel is great for when I need something with a thinner consistency. Love the cute (and hygienic) packaging too!

I wasn't expecting to like this product as much as I did, but it feels so nourishing and has a bit of a cooling sensation after first applying. If you want to try out an affordable eye cream that makes your under eyes feel awake and hydrated, this would be such a great selection for you!
The skin under my eyes tends to be dry and puffy. Snail rescue seems to have restored a smoother more hydrated look.
Great product, very easy to apply, feels great, and I can feel the hydration.
This eye cream is amazing! I use it in the morning and it is extremely hydrating and brightening. The hydration is amazing and brightens my undereyes instantly.

avis.titre: First eye product I'm actually re-buying
avis.texte: The TLDR: comparatively very cheap, actually works to smooth out and blur wrinkles and fine lines, and a little goes a long way so it lasts for a long time I've tried dozens of different eye gels, creams, serums, and moisturizers from tons of brands at varying price points. I was immediately surprised by how well this actually worked. Many eye moisturizers feel very nice and refreshing going on but once they dry it's like they were never there. With this, it only takes a tiny amount to cover the entire under eye area and next to the eye (crows feet land). The gel goes on smooth, not tacky, and dries to a soft finish that isn't sticky or greasy. I fairly instantly see my under-eye bags, fine lines, and crows feet disappear. I don't really have dark circles, so I can't speak to any brightening effect as that isn't a goal of mine. I have not had any issues with breaking out from this gel, which is a problem I've had with greasier products. After multiple days of use, my lines are much less noticeable, even after waking up as the product has improved the overall hydration around my eyes. When I forget to use it, I really notice a difference in how dry the skin around my eyes gets.
They are inexpensive products and do a good job; you notice the difference from the first week.

I didn't much care for this product, it felt black.I was putting vaseline under my eyes? There wasn't that silky music field to it.It felt just like straight up.Vaseline , and hasn't really done anything for me under the eyes. I don't have dark circles or anything, but just a few wrinkles.Not many , but it didn't even hydrate those. Just my opinion.

You might as well just use it to moisturize your eyes, but if your hope with this is to brighten your eyes, then you might want to take it out you cart. If you feel like it's "brightening" your eyes then it's probably just the placebo effect

I love this eye gel. I paired the eye gel with the peach slices silicon eye patches and I I've noticed that my under eyes are much lighter and my concealer goes on and stays better. I noticed results in 2 weeks.
I had been using a much more expensive eye cream, but this stuff works so much better! Definitely buying again.

For the past 2 days I have been using this product under my eyes in the morning and in the evening. I already see improvement in the dark under eye area as well as fewer fine lines. My usually sensitive skin has had no issues. A little is all that is needed and it does not feel heavy or suffocating. Highly recommend as an addition to the usual routine.

I could tell immediately that I had never discovered something special . I loved the easy flow of the lotion . It felt like a cool whip of softness , that was being absorbed by my thirsty skin . Someone cares and wants the best for my 70 years of skin . I felt like a whip cream of indulgence, and could see it reflect like a light shimmer of light . I looked in the mirror , and felt great . I'm doing something for me . I just love this product .
So far I like this gel. No irritation around the eyes and skin feels soft and smooth.

I really like this product. It has a silky gel texture that sinks into skin really well. You only need a small amount of product to spread over the entire eye area. It leaves my skin feeling really hydrated and soft and has been working really well as a base under makeup. I don't really have wrinkles yet but I do get what I think are dehydration lines under my eyes and this product has been great for those.

I really like this product. It has a silky gel texture that sinks into skin really well. You only need a small amount of product to spread over the entire eye area. It leaves my skin feeling really hydrated and soft and has been working really well as a base under makeup. I don't really have wrinkles yet but I do get what I think are dehydration lines under my eyes and this product has been great for those.

This eye cream is cooling when you put it on and it leaves the skin feeling soft and supple! I did notice a difference in my under eyes and overall fine lines/dark circles after a couple weeks of use. I did use this product to a T and applied it 2 times a day. (Sometimes 3) I'm giving this review four stars since the difference was only mild and I'm not sure how well it will work on a person with intense dark circles/wrinkles etc. Another concern is the packaging. I ordered this product using an early access link and after 3 weeks of use the sealant on the bottom of the container actually broke. I didn't realize and wasted a lot of product since it began exploding out the side of the top of the container. I was able to fix this with some tape but it was a downer to have a new product be defective in that way. Overall still a great product! I plan to order this again and if the bottle breaks again I will update my review.

at the texture at first, but tapping it in feels very smooth and silky. no burn or sting around my eyes. still new so dk about how it is with brighten dark circles. I'll do a updated review in the future
